title: Traefik — reverse proxy
description: Trafic HTTP, codes, latence (percentiles + heatmap), connexions, TLS, access logs.

targets.expr: (1 - (sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{code=~"5..", service=~"$service", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$__range])), 1)) * 100

(1 - (sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{code=~"5..", service=~"$service", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[2m])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[2m])), 1e-9)) * 100
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$rng])))
sum by (status) (count_over_time({filename="/logs/traefik/access.log", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"} | json | label_format status=DownstreamStatus [$__auto]))
sum by (router) (count_over_time({filename="/logs/traefik/access.log", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"} | json | label_format router=RouterName | router != "" [$__auto]))
topk(15, sum by (client) (count_over_time({filename="/logs/traefik/access.log", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"} | json | label_format client=ClientHost [$__range])))

{filename="/logs/traefik/access.log", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"} | json | RequestDurationMs > 1000 | line_format "{{.DownstreamStatus}} {{.RequestMethod}} {{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}} — {{.RequestDurationMs}} ms ← {{.ClientHost}} [{{.RouterName}}]"
